manual.thermoelectric_generator.line2: {0}Thermoelectric Generators are another kind of power generation, and work without the use of any mechanical parts. These generators use the temperature gradient between two opposing sources to produce power.{1}
manual.thermoelectric_generator.line3: Placing a heat source on one side and a colder source on the opposite side generates energy based on the difference between the two temperatures.{0}
manual.thermoelectric_generator.line4: Any fluid will work based on its temperature, along with some other blocks.{0}
manual.thermoelectric_generator.line5: Temperature gradients are only used across the generator, not across adjacent sides.{0}
manual.thermoelectric_generator.line6: {0}The list below contains non-fluid blocks which can be used as sources of temperature.
